_comment: Exact privileges of the mcp_auth database role (identity plane: OAuth clients/codes/tokens + the minimum user lookup for consent). Source of truth for scripts/setup-mcp-roles.mjs (provision AND exact-match verify). Anything not listed is denied. No DELETE/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER anywhere. NO privilege on audit_log: security events go through the allowlisting SECURITY DEFINER function mcp_audit_event. users.username/password_hash/api_key/member_id, members, team_members and every session/prompt/event table are unreadable. The Phase 3 data plane (mcp_data_owner and mcp_reader) is defined below and rendered into scripts/migrations/mcp-data.grants.sql; scripts/setup-mcp-roles.mjs does NOT read those two entries yet (P3-4).

mcp_data_owner._comment: NOLOGIN owner of schema mcp_data and its functions (SECURITY DEFINER runs as this role). COLUMN-level SELECT only, and only the columns the functions read. Deliberately NOT granted: session_turns.prompt_text_sanitized, sync_sessions.label/events/agent/payload_hash, daily_member_usage.project/source/model, any path column, users.username/password_hash/api_key/member_id, members beyond id+display_name, member_keys, audit_log, prompt_embeddings, redundant_reprompt_events, daily_org_* tables. No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE anywhere.
ownsFunctions: mcp_data.list_sessions(bytea, uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz, text, text, integer, timestamptz, uuid)
mcp_data.search_prompt_metadata(bytea, uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz, text[], boolean, boolean, boolean, integer, integer, text, text, integer, timestamptz, bigint)
mcp_data._session_rows(uuid, uuid, uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz, text, text, integer, timestamptz, uuid)
mcp_data._prompt_rows(uuid, bigint[], uuid, timestamptz, timestamptz, text[], boolean, boolean, boolean, integer, integer, text, text, integer, timestamptz, bigint)

mcp_reader._comment: LOGIN role for the data plane. NO table, sequence or column privilege anywhere (every read of a table is a 42501). USAGE on schema mcp_data and EXECUTE on the six reader functions only; the helpers are not executable by it. Every function derives the team from the token hash. Read-only by default (default_transaction_read_only), which is a DEFAULT a session may override: the real boundary is the absence of privileges. Privileges inherited through PUBLIC cannot be removed per role; grants.sql FAILS CLOSED if they give the role any table, schema-CREATE or extra SECURITY DEFINER access, and mcp-data.audit.sql reports them. Connection limit is a proposal pending connection sizing (CS). search_path is a LIST: each schema is its own quoted element.
